name: Stellantis (STLA)
teaser: Stellantis reports €10.0 billion of net cash, but €4.9 billion is hybrid bonds. At $4.48 the stock is 34.7% below Base $6.87 and prices in a 2.8% margin. Hold; the buy zone starts at $3.09.
llms: Global automaker (Jeep, Ram, Peugeot, Fiat, Opel) with a captive finance arm. Valued on mid-cycle EV to adjusted operating income after recurring charges at 3.5x, cross-checked with a scenario cash flow model; hybrid notes and restructuring cash treated as debt-like. Bear $1.00, Base $6.87, Bull $12.94. Verdict HOLD at $4.48; maximum buy price $3.09 at a required margin of safety of 55%.
